text: こんどこそ　いいとこ　みせるぞ

structure.jp: いいとこ　みせるぞ

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong stress on the word before it: 'this one for sure'. こんどこそ = 'this time for sure'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ is a rough, manly ending that shows strong resolve. みせるぞ = 'I'm going to show you!'
